verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a first-party integration with the OpenAI Agents SDK (Python) that runs agents as Workflows with durable, non-repeated model calls, plus a cookbook for durable agent loops with Claude and raw OpenAI API calls, showing genuine glue-code elimination for those specific stacks. Missing for 10: broader first-party SDK coverage beyond OpenAI Agents SDK/Anthropic cookbook, evidence of framework integrations (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK), and independent/hands-on confirmation of these integrations working in production.
